meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: Claude 可以搜索 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库:先搜出带 ID 的索引,再看时间线了解上下文,最后只取回挑中记录的完整详情,用来回答以前会话里做过什么。
howto.when: 当你问的是以往会话而不是当前对话时触发,例如「这个以前修过吗?」「上次 X 是怎么做的?」「上周发生了什么?」。

say.text: 搜一下 authentication 相关的历史记录
say.note: 先返回带 ID 的索引表

say.text: 上次那个令牌过期的问题是怎么解决的?
看看 #11131 前后各 3 条记录
say.note: 返回该条目的时间线上下文

howto.what_en: Claude gains a 3-step workflow — search past session memory for an index, view a timeline for context, then fetch full details only for the entries you pick — to answer questions about earlier work.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask about previous sessions rather than the current chat, e.g. "did we already fix this?", "how did we solve X last time?", or what happened last week.

say_en.text: Search my memory for authentication history
say_en.note: Returns an index table with IDs

say_en.text: How did we fix the token expiration issue last time?
say_en.note: Searches the index, then fetches details
Returns timeline context around that entry
